themes.title: Manuel Adorni scandal paralyzes Argentina's government
themes.blurb: The resignation of Manuel Adorni, Argentina's Chief of Cabinet, amid corruption allegations has triggered a political crisis, with cross-national reactions from right-wing and far-right figures. The scandal has led to a reshuffling of Argentina's government and sparked debates over political integrity and governance.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Adorni's resignation dominates headlines, with Javier Milei appointing Diego Santilli as his replacement amid ongoing corruption investigations.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: U.S. right-wing media highlights the scandal as emblematic of broader governance failures, drawing parallels to Trump administration controversies.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Italian far-right figures comment on the scandal, framing it as a cautionary tale about political corruption and the fragility of right-wing governance.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Spanish far-right party Vox references the scandal in critiques of Argentina's government, emphasizing themes of political instability and corruption.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: UK far-right media covers the scandal, using it to critique global political elites and advocate for anti-establishment policies.

themes.title: Far-right push for 'national priority' policies
themes.blurb: Right-wing and far-right parties across Europe are intensifying their advocacy for 'national priority' policies, which prioritize citizens over immigrants in access to social services, housing, and employment. This theme has gained traction in Spain, Italy, Hungary, and France, reflecting a broader transnational trend.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox pushes 'national priority' policies in regional budgets, demanding that Spanish citizens be prioritized for social services and housing.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Italian far-right parties advocate for similar policies, emphasizing the need to protect Italian citizens' access to resources and jobs.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Hungary's ruling party frames its policies as prioritizing Hungarian citizens, aligning with broader far-right narratives on national sovereignty.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: France's far-right party promotes 'national preference' policies, advocating for stricter immigration controls and prioritizing French citizens in welfare programs.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Reform UK echoes these themes, calling for policies that prioritize British citizens in housing, healthcare, and employment.

themes.title: Right-wing parties target LGBTQ+ rights in Europe
themes.blurb: Far-right and right-wing parties in Europe are escalating their attacks on LGBTQ+ rights, proposing legislation to restrict Pride events, ban gender-affirming care, and limit legal recognition of LGBTQ+ identities. This theme is particularly prominent in Spain, Hungary, Italy, and France.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox proposes policies to limit LGBTQ+ visibility, including banning Pride events and restricting gender-affirming care for minors.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Hungary's government avoids Pride events and promotes policies that restrict LGBTQ+ rights, framing them as protective of traditional values.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Italian far-right parties criticize Pride events and propose legislation to limit LGBTQ+ rights, particularly targeting transgender individuals.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: France's far-right party opposes LGBTQ+ rights expansions, advocating for policies that prioritize traditional family structures.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Sweden's far-right party proposes policies to limit LGBTQ+ visibility in public spaces and restrict gender-affirming care.

themes.title: Poland-Ukraine tensions over historical symbols
themes.blurb: Poland and Ukraine are locked in a diplomatic dispute over historical symbols, particularly the recognition of Ukrainian nationalist groups from World War II. This theme has resonated with right-wing parties in the U.S., Hungary, and the UK, reflecting broader transnational debates about historical memory and nationalism.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Poland's ruling party escalates tensions with Ukraine over the recognition of UPA, a Ukrainian nationalist group, sparking diplomatic disputes.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: U.S. right-wing media covers the Poland-Ukraine dispute, framing it as part of broader debates about historical memory and nationalism.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Hungary's government comments on the dispute, aligning with Poland's stance and emphasizing the importance of historical memory.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: UK far-right media highlights the Poland-Ukraine tensions, using them to critique globalist policies and advocate for nationalist historical narratives.
